criteria.finding: Both repetitions used the unchanged public v5.1.0 Chromium extension archive after exact SHA-256 and size verification. The runtime reported yours-wallet-5.1.0.

The production extension ran on mainnet through its normal installation and wallet-creation flow. Its fixed production service identities were routed to isolated fixtures without changing the extension bytes.
Each repetition used a fresh Chromium persistent context, a new wallet identity and temporary controlled-service state. Undeclared outbound destinations were blocked and recorded.

The laboratory controlled the extension's Wallet Storage, transaction-submission, header/proof, application-origin and declared auxiliary service destinations. Route transcripts are retained for both repetitions.
Each wallet internalized an independently validated mainnet-format BRC-29 fixture transaction and Merkle proof. The fixture is expressly separate from a public-mainnet UTXO or acceptance claim.

All eight vectors received explicit outcomes. V001 through V004 passed; V005 and V006 failed; V007 and V008 recorded the remaining multi-remote and clause-corpus blockers. Raw BEEF, decoded PushDrop fields, wallet projections, permission observations, service verdicts and method inventory are retained.
Two clean repetitions produced the same semantic projection and the same vector outcomes. Transaction identifiers differ because each repetition uses a newly generated wallet identity.
The public release URL and exact digest are retained. An accepted artifact-submission grant for indefinite redistribution of the extension archive remains outstanding.
